row.notes: Championship step that virtualises (simulates) the sessions not driven by players. First, if the game mode (self+0x278) has component 0x146063fb0 and the live session type matches 0x14604ec60, collects sessions of the current event (+0x220..+0x228, 0xa0 stride, event +0x23c == 1) that still need a run, checking entrant flags (+0x4b bit 0x10). Game.AlwaysVirtualiseSessionsIndividually (lea 0x140bd42c8) -> Ne_Get_SettingBool 0x143a43b90 on *(0x146ca5e28)+0x18, default 0, into a local: only when it is 0 and both 0x14077cee0(mode) and 0x14077c790(mode,1) are false does the function take the batch path (component vtable +0x98, 0x1407c66e0, 0x140af7130(...,2)); otherwise each pending session goes through Game_Championship_VirtualiseSession 0x140bd4bc0 one by one (calls 0x140bd441c, 0x140bd4975, 0x140bd4a14, 0x140bd4b2c), with entrant vectors copied by Sess_Assign_EntrantVector 0x140bd5100 and helpers 0x140bd4ef0 / 0x140bd4fb0. Caller 0x1413309b6 in unnamed 0x141330770 (the rip match 0x140bcf324 is a false positive inside a mov immediate). hidden-modes 2026-11-13 (vmknolle-hidden-a): read from the Ghidra decompile.
